_README: Hand-labelled ground truth. Each case is a defect this pipeline ACTUALLY shipped,
with the measured numbers that proved it, taken from the run record.
This file is how your eyes get deposited into the system permanently. Every time
you spot something on screen that the gates missed, add a case here. From then on
it is checked in milliseconds, on every gate change, forever — instead of being
re-discovered by you on the next render.
expect.blocked      — must the ladder STOP this run?
expect.gates        — gate names that must appear in blocking_failures
expect.not_blocked_by — gates that must NOT block it (false-positive guards)

provenance: The paste-back post-process was erasing the animation the model had
produced correctly all along. Decisive A/B on the SAME clip, before vs
after paste_back_keep_regions: a_hand 0.254 -> 0.080 (-68%).
The pinned book box contained Abel's writing hand, so restoring anchor
pixels over the keep region pasted a static hand over every frame.
RULE: a keep-region pins a WORLD-STATIC SURFACE, so anything that moves
across it must be subtracted per frame.
This is the single most valuable case in the corpus: it is the defect the
self-improvement loop independently re-derived from measurements alone.

cases.margin: THIN — flow 0.201 vs adaptive floor 0.209 (4%). Kept as a true positive by the gate's own calibration, but flagged: a 4% margin is close to where the churn half was rejected. If this case starts flapping, the floor needs a control arm, not a nudge.
provenance: Early 4-region probe-era run.
BEST run on disk: output/multichar_seated/scene20_v28/FINAL_scene20_v28.mp4.
It finishes with 46 failed checks and 10 defect tags. If arming the ladder
blocks THIS, the ladder is wrong, not the render.
Specifically it must not block on prop_ncc: props decay with elapsed
generated time (wall-stable ~5s, 4-6x worse by ~s12), so the final seam of
every 20s clip fails a fixed 0.70 floor. That is the model, not a defect.
Known-good: passes the eye-aperture replay that correctly fails v15/v17/v20.
Its boy_hands churn_p95 is 0.684 against a 0.55 floor while flow_mean is
1.184 — moving fine, edges busy. Blocking on that would have stopped a
good render, which is why the churn half sits at warn.
pipe churn_p95 0.553 vs a 0.55 floor — a 0.5% margin, i.e. noise.
A gate cannot hold authority at its own noise floor. This case exists to
make any future promotion of region_churn fail loudly.
man_head churn 0.636. v20 has a REAL defect — Cornelis 29% eyes closed,
the pipe plate was off — but region_churn is not the gate that sees it.
eye_openness is. This case guards against the wrong gate taking credit.

known_uncovered._note: Defect classes NO gate in the registry detects. These are the rows where your eyes are still the only instrument. Shrinking this list is the roadmap.

why_they_matter.texture-collapse: waxy skin cost ~4.5h of GPU and a full LoRA trained on 48 anime images before a 12-render A/B found the real lever. cheek-band Laplacian exists in the contact-sheet path but is not wired into video QC.
why_they_matter.style-collapse: the 2026-07-15 anime-collapse incident: 30/49 faces undetectable. A style gate exists for contact sheets (ZYG_ANCHOR_STYLE_GATE); video has none.
why_they_matter.audio-loss: narration/bed gates exist as CLAP checks in the audio path but emit no pipeline_debug checks, so they are invisible to this ladder.
